defs.def: to bite food into small pieces in your mouth with your teeth to make it easier to swallow 咀嚼；嚼碎

ex.s: In the book it said: “Boa constrictors swallow their prey whole, without chewing it.
ex.t: 书中说: “ 蟒蛇不加咀嚼，就把猎物整个吞下去。

ex.s: Food became easier to chew at this point.
ex.t: 此时食物变得更容易咀嚼。

ex.s: The Little Tramp chews on the lower part of the boot, treating it like something good to eat and making you believe that this is one of the best meals he has ever tasted.
ex.t: 小流浪汉在靴子的下部咀嚼，把它当作好吃的东西对待，让你相信这是他吃过的最好的食物之一。

defs.def: to bite sth continuously, for example because you are nervous or to taste it （因为紧张等）咬住，不停地啃；（为尝味道）不停地咀嚼

ex.s: What this means is that people who chew too quickly end up eating too much food because they still feel hungry.
ex.t: 这意味着咀嚼太快的人最终会因为仍然感到饥饿而吃太多食物。

ex.s: He makes an attempt to eat it, but it is clear from the look on his face as he is chewing that he finds the taste truly awful.
ex.t: 他试图吃它，但从他咀嚼时的表情可以清楚地看出，他发现味道真的很糟糕。

ex.s: Three camels, slowly chewing, were resting on their knees and watching our arrival with interest.
ex.t: 三只骆驼缓慢嚼着东西，跪着休息，饶有兴致地望着我们的到来。

defs.def: an act of chewing sth 咀嚼
a type of sweet/candy that you chew 口香糖
a piece of tobacco that you chew 供嚼用的烟草
